name: Cooper Dagny
title: Of Hoops and Staves
examine: Forearms like bent staves and a laugh you can hear over a mallet. There is not a cask on the High Road she has not had her hands in.
lines: The Flagon's cellar, the smelter's quench tubs, every cask on the High Road. All mine. Nobody ever remembers the cooper.
Staves, hoops, a tight head. Get one of the three wrong and you're mopping.
Stig sends me his straightest staves and keeps the crooked ones for his chairs.
